title: Pocket Fuel Ultra Berry Shortfill E-Liquid
description: With the taste of seven delicious berries packed into one incredible e-liquid, Ultra Berry from Pocket Fuel is a symphony of fruity flavour with a rich, tangy sweetness and deliciously smooth finish that will have your taste buds drooling for more. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 80VG/20PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
